definitions.dark_night: At least one raw cloud-mask 0/1 pass and no source-copy detection within 1.5 km on any pass that night, including cloudy detections. A night is not listed when another source unit within 1.5 km had its own detections that night: the two cannot be told apart reliably.
definitions.burning_rate: More than half of at least 10 clear nights within 14 nights before or after had a detection within 1 km or nearest this source unit. Exclude the selected night and nights with only a neighbour's detections within 1.5 km; show that excluded count. Other dark nights count as unlit. A lit clear night must precede the run inside that window.
definitions.recent_heat: Median measured heat over lit clear nights in that window, using clear source groups within 1 km; n counts nights with heat measured. Missing heat stays unmeasured.
definitions.run: One row per run of clear dark nights. Cloud-only and unobserved nights do not break a run; any detection ends it. Each qualifying night keeps its own rate, heat and passes.
definitions.provisional: Fewer than 14 subsequent nights have been processed; the burning rate can change next month.
definitions.order: Most surprising combines the 95% Wilson lower bound of lit/clear nights with 1 minus (1-p)^k, using the heat class's same-night re-detection rate p and k clear passes. Highest first, then higher recent heat. A run uses its best night. Passes on one night are not independent; this is a review order, not a probability.
definitions.passes: One exposure per satellite pass. View zone: near nadir 1008–2191; swath edge below 640 or at least 2560; otherwise mid-swath.
definitions.bracket: Last pass that saw the source before the run, first and last clear dark passes, and first pass that saw it after. The next detection is unknown while still dark.
definitions.emit: Scenes from two local nights before the run through two nights after. D59 labels follow the VIIRS bracket: before, during, boundary, after. A daytime scene beside a single dark night is usually boundary.
definitions.comparison: Up to three scenes per source, lit on the nearest VIIRS passes on both sides, outside every listed run's two-night scene window. Closest to the dark passes first.
definitions.imagery: At most 60 new scene renders per build by default. Reserve half the budget, rounded up, for never-attempted scenes. Retry failures after 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, then 32 days. Cached chips use no budget; scenes beyond the measured Earth Engine horizon stay pending.
definitions.neighbours: Link runs at other listed sources within 1.5 km when they share a clear dark night; their detection apertures overlap.

limits: A dark night is not evidence of an outage; most single dark nights at steady flares are unexplained. EMIT scenes are daytime, hours from the VIIRS passes. The CH4 index is not a concentration.
caption: Quick-look relative CH4 absorption index, not a calibrated methane concentration or emission rate. Surface, cloud and water effects can produce signal; no plume has been confirmed by this screen. Grey marks missing EMIT data; dark blue (#00131f) marks index values <=1 sigma.
